dossier.scp_unleashed.009.title: Red Ice
dossier.scp_unleashed.009.caption: SCP-009 at intake, held in a frosted cradle beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-009 is to be kept in a storage container fitted with a Cold Storage Upgrade. While refrigerated it is inert. It is never to leave cold storage except inside a sealed containment case.
SCP-009 may be handled only by personnel wearing a full hazmat suit: hood, suit, trousers and boots. **No bare skin is to come into contact with SCP-009 or with any instance of SCP-009-1.**

No liquid water is to be stored, piped or carried near the containment unit. Fragments recovered after an incident are to be sealed into a case or a refrigerated unit at once. Red ice formations are as dangerous as SCP-009 itself and are to be broken up only by suited personnel.
Exposed personnel and animals cannot be treated. They are to be led away from water and from other staff for the time remaining.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-009 is a shard of translucent red crystal about 11 cm long, resembling amethyst in its habit. It feels cool in every environment tested, yet it never frosts over.

At any temperature above that of cold storage, SCP-009 acts on the water inside living bodies. An unprotected person or animal that touches it, or comes within roughly 10 m of it while it lies uncontained and in plain view, begins to freeze from within.

Within about a minute the subject's movements slow and their vision fills with red. At the end of this period the body turns entirely to red crystal. A brittle statue is left standing in the subject's last posture, and small fragments, designated SCP-009-1, shear away from it. Smaller animals leave fewer fragments.
SCP-009-1 shares every property of SCP-009, wherever it lies.

When SCP-009 or SCP-009-1 is thrown into liquid water, the object dissolves and the water around it crystallises into solid red ice. The reaction spreads only a few metres before it stops. The crystal affects the living exactly as SCP-009 does, and breaking it apart yields further SCP-009-1.

page.title: Addendum 009-1: Incident Log
text: Incident 009-03: a technician lifted an instance of SCP-009-1 from a drain grate without gloves. Crystallisation was complete within a minute. Five fragments were recovered.

Incident 009-07: the refrigeration unit was removed for servicing while SCP-009 remained inside. Two researchers behind the observation window were unaffected. A third, standing at the open door, was not.
Incident 009-11: a recovered fragment was dropped into a cooling pond. The surface crystallised outward for several metres and then stopped. %rRemainder of report withheld.%r

page.title: Addendum 009-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-009 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file inside a sealed containment case, by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The case was intact on arrival. The individual warned the recipient not to open it unprotected. %rThe warning was not heeded.%r See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp009_shard.tooltip: A shard of red crystal, like amethyst. It is never quite cold enough.
item.scp_unleashed.scp009_fragment.toolt: A splinter of SCP-009. It is still growing.
item.scp_unleashed.scp009.touch: Fatal to touch without a full hazmat suit

jade.scp_unleashed.scp009_red_ice.mine: Mine with a pickaxe to recover SCP-009-1
jade.scp_unleashed.scp009_containment.ra: Lethal to all unprotected life within %s blocks
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_shard.1: SCP-009 turns the water inside living bodies to red ice. Touch it without a full hazmat suit and you are doomed: within a minute you slow down and your vision turns red, then you shatter into SCP-009-1 fragments.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_shard.2: It is inert inside a Sealed Containment Case, or in a Storage Container fitted with a Cold Storage Upgrade. Anywhere else, whether lying loose, carried by a player or mob, or stored in a chest, it dooms every unprotected creature within 10 blocks that has a clear line to it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_shard.3: Tossed into water by a player, it dissolves and turns up to 64 nearby water blocks, no further than 6 blocks away, into red ice, which is just as deadly. Mine the red ice with a pickaxe to recover SCP-009-1.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_shard.4: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-009 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress will find you and hand it over in a sealed case. Wear a full hazmat suit before you open it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_fragment.1: SCP-009-1 are fragments of SCP-009. They shear off anything that dies while doomed, which leaves a red ice statue behind, and they drop from mined red ice and broken statues.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_fragment.2: They follow the same rules as SCP-009: fatal to touch or carry without a full hazmat suit, deadly to anything unprotected nearby whether loose, carried or in a chest, and inert only in cold storage or a sealed case.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_fragment.3: Tossed into water by a player, each fragment turns up to 16 nearby water blocks, no further than 3 blocks away, into red ice. Fragments that merely fall into water do not.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_red_ice.1: Red ice forms when a player tosses SCP-009 or SCP-009-1 into water. It glows faintly, is slippery underfoot and rings when struck. Like SCP-009 itself, it dooms every unprotected creature within 10 blocks that can see it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp009_red_ice.2: Mine it with a pickaxe for SCP-009-1 fragments; Fortune adds more and Silk Touch takes the block whole. Creatures that die to SCP-009 leave red ice statues of themselves; break one to recover its fragments.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp009.0: The courier brought this one in a sealed case.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp009.1: Wait somewhere dry, and come dressed for it.
